# PocketRun (`feature/file-manager`) — Research Report

Repo root: `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code` · branch `feature/file-manager` · HEAD `d5c9f92 "Show the files inside a project"` · working tree clean.

Stack: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, CPython 3.13 via Chaquopy 17, Rhino 1.8.1 + a hand-written Node layer (`assets/node/boot.js`), a custom npm client, an "opencode"-style agent with 13 tools, GitHub REST + Actions integration, in-app APK updater.

---

## 1. FILE MANAGER UI

### 1.1 Files involved

| Path | Lines | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/ProjectsScreen.kt` | 703 | The file manager screen (tab 0). Composables: `ProjectsScreen` (86), `FileToolbar` (403), `TreeRow` (481), `FileActionBar` (519), `SearchResults` (593), `NameDialog` (633), `ConfirmDialog` (668), `iconFor` (683), `EntryDialog` (698) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/AppViewModel.kt` | 1602 | All state/handlers: `openFile` (931), `toggleFolder` (893), `inspect` (921), `rebuildTree` (820), `rebuildTreeAsync` (834), `refreshFiles` (838), `startWatching` (856), `openInEditor` (941), `showPreview` (1144), `openExternally` (1100), `shareFile` (1109) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/core/FileTree.kt` | 224 | `FileKind` (11), `FileNode` (23), `TreeFilter` (37), `FileTree.build` (129), `walk` (137), `fingerprint` (206), `SKIP_DIRS` (56) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/FileViewer.kt` | 301 | `FileViewerDialog` (66), `ImageViewer`, `AudioViewer`, `VideoViewer`, `OtherViewer` |

All UI strings are hardcoded Russian in Kotlin — `android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` contains only `app_name`.

### 1.2 The "Открыть" / "Открыть папку" button — exact code path

The button lives in the bottom action bar that appears for the *inspected* entry (selected by long-press):

`ProjectsScreen.kt:283-294`
```kotlin
if (inspected != null) {
    FileActionBar(
        file = inspected!!,
        onOpen = { viewModel.openFile(inspected!!) },   // <-- line 286
        onRename = { dialog = EntryDialog.Rename(inspected!!) },
        ...
```

`ProjectsScreen.kt:543-546` — the button itself
```kotlin
Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
    OutlinedButton(onClick = onOpen, contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp)) {
        Text(if (file.isDirectory) "Открыть папку" else "Открыть", fontSize = 13.sp)
    }
```

Click path: `onOpen` → `AppViewModel.openFile` → `AppViewModel.toggleFolder` → `AppViewModel.rebuildTreeAsync()` → (guard) → `FileTree.build`.

`AppViewModel.kt:926-939`
```kotlin
/**
 * Opens a file the way its type asks for: a folder expands, code and text go
 * to the editor, and everything else goes to the built-in viewer or, when
 * there is nothing to show it with, to a system app.
 */
fun openFile(file: File) {
    _inspected.value = file
    val kind = FileTree.kindOf(file)
    when {
        kind == FileKind.FOLDER -> toggleFolder(file)   // <-- folders never navigate
        FileTree.isTextual(kind) -> openInEditor(file)  // requests tab 1
        else -> showPreview(file)
    }
}
```

`AppViewModel.kt:893-898`
```kotlin
fun toggleFolder(file: File) {
    val path = file.absolutePath
    _expandedDirs.value =
        if (path in _expandedDirs.value) _expandedDirs.value - path else _expandedDirs.value + path
    rebuildTreeAsync()          // <-- force = false
}
```

Note: for a folder, `openFile` **only flips a set membership**. There is no navigation: no "current directory" state, no breadcrumb, no "go up". The tree is always rooted at `selected.dir` (`AppViewModel.kt:821`, `:830`). Contrast with a text file, which sets `_tabRequest.value = TAB_EDITOR` (`AppViewModel.kt:954`) and the tab bar actually switches (`App.kt:55-62`).

### 1.3 Why opening a folder does not work — the fingerprint guard bug (primary cause)

`AppViewModel.kt:815-836`
```kotlin
private fun rebuildTree(force: Boolean = false) {
    val dir = _selected.value?.dir
    if (dir == null) { treePrint = ""; if (_tree.value.isNotEmpty()) _tree.value = emptyList(); return }
    val print = FileTree.fingerprint(dir)
    if (!force && print == treePrint) return          // <-- line 828: THE BUG
    treePrint = print
    _tree.value = FileTree.build(dir, _expandedDirs.value, _treeFilter.value)
}

private fun rebuildTreeAsync(force: Boolean = false) {
    ioExecutor.execute { rebuildTree(force) }
}
```

`FileTree.fingerprint` (`FileTree.kt:206-223`) hashes only names, lengths and mtimes. It is **completely independent of `_expandedDirs` and `_treeFilter`**. Therefore:

1. `select()` → `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)` (`:1277`) → `treePrint = P`, tree built collapsed.
2. User long-presses a folder → `inspect()` (`:921-924`) → the bottom bar appears. Tree unchanged.
3. User taps **"Открыть папку"** → `openFile` → `toggleFolder` → `_expandedDirs += path`, `rebuildTreeAsync()` with `force = false` → line 828 short-circuits (`P == treePrint`) → **`_tree` is never reassigned → the folder's children never appear.**
4. The 2-second watcher cannot rescue it either — `startWatching` calls plain `rebuildTree()` (`:862`), which also short-circuits on the same fingerprint.
5. Tapping again flips the set back (toggle), still no rebuild.

So the only things that make the folder actually open are an **unrelated** disk write inside the project (agent writing a file, an editor save, an import, create/rename/delete — all `force = true`) or the manual **"Обновить"** button (`ProjectsScreen.kt:115` → `AppViewModel.refreshFiles()` → `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)`, `:838-841`).

**Misleading UI:** `_expandedDirs` is its own `StateFlow` that *does* update, and `ProjectsScreen.kt:266` passes `expanded = node.file.absolutePath in expanded` into `TreeRow`, which flips the icon to `Icons.Filled.FolderOpen` / contentDescription "Свернуть" (`ProjectsScreen.kt:509-515`). Result: the row shows an *open folder* icon with **zero children listed** — the UI actively asserts it worked.

### 1.4 The same bug affects every filter control

All of these call `rebuildTreeAsync()` **without** `force`:

| Handler | Line | UI control |
|---|---|---|
| `toggleFolder` | 897 | "Открыть папку" / tree row tap |
| `setTreeQuery` | 902 | "поиск по имени" text field (`ProjectsScreen.kt:420`) |
| `setTreeKind` | 907 | kind filter chips (`ProjectsScreen.kt:206-210`) |
| `toggleHiddenFiles` | 912 | dotfile toggle button (`ProjectsScreen.kt:451`) |
| `clearTreeFilter` | 918 | "сбросить фильтр" chip (`ProjectsScreen.kt:464`) |

So typing in the name filter, switching the kind chip, or toggling hidden files is also a visual no-op until the folder contents change on disk. `contentMode` search (`searchContent`, `:1188`) does work because it bypasses the tree entirely.

### 1.5 Secondary problems in the folder-open path

1. **Toggle semantics on a button labelled "Открыть папку".** Because the row tap already calls `openFile` (→ toggle), the sequence "tap row (expands) → tap Открыть папку (collapses)" is inverted once the guard bug is fixed. Two entry points share one toggle action.
2. **Dead long-press handler.** `TreeRow` declares `onLongPress` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:481`) and `ProjectsScreen.kt:268` passes `viewModel.inspect(node.file)`, but the body only binds `.clickable(onClick = onClick)` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:485`) — `onLongPress` is never referenced (no `combinedClickable`/`onLongClick` anywhere in the file). So there is no way to inspect an entry without also opening it; the only real way `inspected` gets set for a folder is through `openFile` itself.
3. **No `LaunchedEffect`/`derivedStateOf`** anywhere in `ProjectsScreen.kt` — nothing reacts to `expandedDirs`/`treeFilter` changing. The rebuild is entirely ViewModel-driven.
4. **No test coverage.** There is no `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/` directory at all. `FileTreeTest.kt:54-63` proves `FileTree.build` honours an expanded set correctly, so the defect is exclusively in `AppViewModel.rebuildTree`.

### 1.6 What does work in the screen (for contrast)

- Per-node folder/file counts (`FileTree.node`, `FileTree.kt:157-171`).
- Content search (`ContentSearch.search`, `AppViewModel.kt:1188-1207`) — bypasses the tree.
- Create / create folder / rename / delete (`ProjectsScreen.kt:297-343`), with `FileOps` name validation and history snapshots on delete (`AppViewModel.kt:1010`).
- Import from the phone via SAF `OpenMultipleDocuments` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:105-109`, `AppViewModel.importFromPhone` `:1053`) — no storage permission, 512 MB cap (`:1565`).
- Share / hand to another app via `FileProvider` (`:1109-1140`).
- Built-in image/audio/video/other viewer + "Открыть системным приложением" fallback (`FileViewer.kt:296`, `AppViewModel.kt:1100`).
- Disk-change watcher + editor conflict banner (`AppViewModel.kt:856-891`, `EditorScreen.kt:150-166`).

---

## 2. RUNTIME / JS

### 2.1 `assets/node` contents — the whole bundle is one file

```
android/app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js      46 203 bytes   1 061 lines
```

That is the **only** file in `android/app/src/main/assets/`. No `node_modules`, no vendored packages, no pre-installed binaries, no `package.json`, no tarball cache. It is loaded as a string:

`AppViewModel.kt:188-194`
```kotlin
val jsRuntime: JsRuntime by lazy {
    val boot = getApplication<Application>().assets.open("node/boot.js")
        .bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
    JsRuntime(boot, workspace)
}
val npxRuntime: NpxRuntime by lazy { NpxRuntime(jsRuntime, workspace) }
```

`JsRuntime.VERSION = "Rhino 1.8.1 (ES6,interpreted)"` (`JsRuntime.kt:58`). Dependency: `implementation("org.mozilla:rhino:1.8.1")` (`build.gradle.kts:213`).

### 2.2 How the JS runtime is set up

`runtime/js/JsRuntime.kt` (477 lines):

- Single daemon worker thread `pocketrun-js-run` (`:61-63`); runs serialized because Rhino contexts are not shareable.
- `runLocked` (`:148-224`): `Context.enter()`, `languageVersion = VERSION_ES6`, `optimizationLevel = -1` (required on Android), `initSafeStandardObjects()`, `installBridge(...)`, then `cx.evaluateString(scope, bootSource, "boot.js", ...)` (`:155`).
- Entry module: `__setMainDir(dir)` (`:161`) then `evaluateString(source)` (`:166`).
- Event loop after the main script returns, driven by boot.js hooks `__prPending` / `__prNextDue` / `__prRunDue` / `__prExitCode` / `__prOnExit` (`:185-216`), with a hard `maxRunMs = 10 min` cap (`:49`, `:180`).
- Bridge `__pr` installed as `BaseFunction` subclasses (NOT `javaToJS`), so the safe scope never sees Java objects (`:260-273`). Kotlin `null` is deliberately mapped to JS `null`, not `undefined` (`:266-268`).
- Output via `workspace/cache/runs/<uuid>/out.log|err.log` + two `OutputTailer`s (`:84-91`), mirroring PythonRuntime.
- `executeSync(request, timeoutMs)` (`:130-144`) → used by the agent's `bash` tool and the editor.
- Entry script is re-validated through `Workspace.resolve` (`readMainSource`, `:232-238`), and shebangs are stripped (`:237`).

### 2.3 npm packages: **downloaded on demand, nothing vendored**

`runtime/npm/` implements a mini npm client against `https://registry.npmjs.org/`:

| File | Lines | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `NpmRegistry.kt` | 190 | HTTP to the registry. `metadata(name)` (`:29`), `downloadTarball(url, dest, integrity)` (`:49`). Hardened: **`dist.integrity` is mandatory** (`:71-82`, refuses metadata without a digest), **sha512/384/256/1** (`:188`), tarball must be **https** and on the **same host as the registry** (`:112-127`), failing tarball deleted (`:57`). UA `pocketrun-npm/1.2 (Rhino)` (`:172`). |
| `NpxRuntime.kt` | 371 | Spec parsing (`parseSpec` `:43`, `parseCommandLine` `:56`), install into `workspace/packages/<name>` (`install` `:204`), dependency tree with hoisting + nesting on conflict (`installDependencies` `:245`, `installInto` `:280`), limits `MAX_PACKAGES = 40`, `MAX_DEPTH = 4` (`:38-39`), version resolution incl. dist-tags (`chooseVersion` `:331`), `bin` resolution re-validated through `Workspace.resolve` (`:353-370`), `uninstall` (`:313`), `installedPackages()` (`:89`). |
| `TarReader.kt` | 127 | Minimal ustar `.tgz` reader. Strips `package/`, skips symlinks/pax/long-names (`:50`), rejects absolute and `..` paths (`:115-116`), forces every path under dest (`:121-126`). |
| `Semver.kt` | 200 | semver parse/compare, `^ ~ >= <`, x-ranges, `\|\|`, prerelease rules. |

Install root: `Workspace.packages = <filesDir>/workspace/packages` (`Workspace.kt:16`). `boot.js:1008-1022` (`resolveInNodeModules`) walks up looking in `node_modules/` **and** in `packages/` — that is the only reason a top-level install is visible to `require()`.

Explicit omissions, documented in code: **native addons and postinstall scripts are skipped** (`NpxRuntime.kt:28-29`), and packages using `class` / `async` / `import` fail to parse (Rhino limitation) — surfaced with a hint at `NpxRuntime.kt:189-195` ("try cowsay@1.4.0 instead of cowsay@latest").

### 2.4 Python runtime (for contrast)

`runtime/python/PythonRuntime.kt` (238 lines): Chaquopy, started once from `PocketRunApplication.onCreate` (`PythonRuntime.initAsync`, `:46-65`). Target + cwd resolved through `Workspace.resolve` (`:112-118`). Cancellation is cooperative only → exit code 130 (`:152`, documented `:91-93`). **Python packages are build-time only** — there is no `pip` at runtime (`docs/PLAN.md:55-64`, `OpenCodeAgent.kt:224`).

`runtime/Exec.kt` (58 lines) holds `RuntimeKind{PYTHON,NODE,NPX}`, `ExecRequest`, `ExecResult`, `OutputListener`, `ExecutionHandle`, `ScriptRuntime`. `runtime/OutputTailer.kt` (146 lines) tails the log files.

## 4. NETWORK / DOWNLOAD

All networking is plain `java.net.HttpURLConnection`/`URL` (no OkHttp, no WorkManager, no DownloadManager). `INTERNET` + `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are the only network permissions.

| Consumer | Endpoint | Mechanism | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| **npm registry client** | `https://registry.npmjs.org/` (default `baseUrl`, overridable) | packument JSON + `.tgz` download, integrity-verified, host-pinned | `NpmRegistry.kt:24,29,49,112,163` |
| **npm installer** | same | downloads tarball → `TarReader.extract` into `workspace/packages/`, recursive deps | `NpxRuntime.kt:204-311` |
| **npm via agent `bash`** | same | `npm install` → `NpxRuntime.install` | `MiniShell.kt:488-518` |
| **`http`/`https` from JS scripts** | any http(s) | synchronous bridge call, 15 s connect / 60 s read, 4 MB body cap | `JsRuntime.kt:364-370, 398-447` |
| **`webfetch` tool** | any http(s) | 10 s / 30 s, UA `Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)` | `OpenCodeTools.kt:428-446` |
| **GitHub REST (agent tool)** | `https://api.github.com` | repos, files, workflows, dispatch, runs, run_wait, logs, artifacts, arbitrary `api` | `GitHubClient.kt` (484 lines) |
| **Remote opencode instructions** | any http(s) from `opencode.json` | 5 s timeout, 48 KB cap | `Instructions.kt:103-112` |
| **LLM chat + model list** | user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint | SSE streaming `POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions`, `GET /models` | `LlmClient.kt:66,226,276,312` |
| **In-app APK updater** | `https://api.github.com/repos/{BuildConfig.UPDATE_REPO}/releases/latest` → `browser_download_url` | `.part` file then rename, progress callback, 512 MB cap; installed via `ACTION_VIEW` + `FileProvider` | `AppUpdater.kt:20,40,118`; `AppViewModel.kt:1473,1497,1513` |
| **License** | **none** | fully offline Ed25519; the shared key is baked into the APK | `LicenseManager.kt`, `build.gradle.kts:71-72,183-191` |

### 4.1 Package-manager / registry integration — the "install package" capability

There is exactly **one** package-manager integration and it is **npm-only, JS-only, pure-JS-only**:

- Entry points: `npx` in the bash tool (`MiniShell.kt:436`), `npm install` in the bash tool (`MiniShell.kt:488`), and the **NPX editor tab** (`EditorScreen.kt:167-192`, `AppViewModel.npxCommand` default `"cowsay@1.4.0 Привет, PocketRun!"` `:152`, `runNpxCommand` `:1392-1411`).
- No agent-facing `install`/`npm_install` tool exists — the model must go through `bash`.
- **No Python `pip` at runtime** (stdlib only; pip packages are a build-time Chaquopy concern, `docs/PLAN.md:55-64`, `OpenCodeAgent.kt:224`).
- No lockfile, no integrity pinning beyond `dist.integrity`, no cache eviction (`NpxRuntime.kt:213-219` reuses an install whose version satisfies the range), no offline mode, no mirror configuration in the UI (the `baseUrl` parameter exists but nothing surfaces it — `NpmRegistry.kt:24`).
- Install budget `MAX_PACKAGES = 40`, depth `MAX_DEPTH = 4` per run (`NpxRuntime.kt:38-39, 220, 253, 290`).

### 4.2 Update mechanism

`checkUpdateOnStart()` (`AppViewModel.kt:1546-1555`) fires **once per 24 h** (`CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `:1559`), gated on an active license, timestamp persisted in the `"updates"` SharedPreferences. Called from the UI when the license becomes active (`App.kt:35-37`). Asset selection prefers `*-release.apk` and rejects debug (`AppUpdate.kt:22,44-51`). Download → `cacheDir/updates/` (`:1538`) → `FileProvider` authority `${applicationId}.updates` → `ACTION_VIEW` with `application/vnd.android.package-archive`. Nothing installs itself; the system installer asks the user. `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` is declared (`AndroidManifest.xml:7`).

### 5.4 What escapes the sandbox (intentionally, all user-mediated)

1. **Share / "open with" a project file** — `ACTION_SEND` / `ACTION_VIEW` with `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` and a one-shot `FileProvider` grant scoped to `workspace/` (`AppViewModel.kt:1109-1131`; `res/xml/share_paths.xml`).
2. **APK update install** — `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` + `FileProvider` authority `.updates` scoped to `cache/updates/` (`AppViewModel.kt:1513-1526`; `res/xml/update_paths.xml`).
3. **Import from the phone** — SAF `OpenMultipleDocuments` via the system picker; read through `ContentResolver`, no storage permission (`AppViewModel.kt:1048-1076`).
4. **Remote effects with the user's own credentials** — the `github` tool can create repos, push code, dispatch workflows and run commands on GitHub-hosted runners using the user's PAT from `AgentSettings` (`OpenCodeTools.kt:472-529`). This is the widest blast radius in the app: the agent can execute arbitrary shell **on someone else's CI machine** (`OpenCodeAgent.kt:246-271` even ships a ready-made workflow YAML that installs `opencode-ai` globally and runs it). Gated only by `MODE_MANUAL` approval (auto mode = no prompt).
5. **Outbound network to arbitrary hosts** — `webfetch` (`:428-446`), the JS `http`/`https` bridge (`JsRuntime.kt:398-431`), and remote instructions URLs from `opencode.json` (`Instructions.kt:103-112`).

### 5.5 Repo-hygiene finding (outside the app, but relevant to "global state")

The release signing material and the shared license key are **committed to git**, not just present locally:

```
android/keystore.properties      (tracked)
android/keystore/release.p12    (tracked)  — 2 710 bytes, password "pocketrun"
android/shared-license.key      (tracked)  — a valid PRK1 Ed25519 license, plan=pro, no expiry
android/license.pubkey           (tracked)
hub-snapshot-builds/*.apk        (tracked)  — 35.8 MB debug + 18.9 MB release
```

`git check-ignore` reports none of them as ignored — `.gitignore:3-6` lists `keystore.properties`, `*.jks`, `*.keystore`, but tracking wins over gitignore, and `.p12` is not listed at all. `build.gradle.kts:174-191` even documents the shared key as *"public by design — the license gate is a formality here, not a protection"*, and `.github/workflows/build-hub-snapshot.yml:115-127` pulls the keystore pair from the default branch by raw URL. Anyone with read access to the repo can produce an update-signed APK.

---

## 6. BUILD / TEST

### 6.1 Local commands

Wrapper: `android/gradlew` (Gradle **8.11.1**, `android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`). Separate JVM project: `tools/keygen/gradlew` (same wrapper version). AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.0.21, Chaquopy 17.0.0 (`android/build.gradle.kts`). JDK 17 required; Python **3.13** on the build machine for Chaquopy `.pyc` precompilation (`build.gradle.kts:142-159`).

```bash
# Unit tests (JVM, no emulator)
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testDebugUnitTest

# Python sandbox jail tests (plain CPython, no emulator)
python3 -m unittest discover -s android/app/src/test/python -v

# Build
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleRelease     # needs android/keystore.properties

# License keygen self-test
tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen test

# Issue a license key
tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="issue --name 'Jane Doe' --seat laptop --plan pro --days 30"
```

`android/build.gradle.kts:49-58` makes `packageRelease` fail with a clear `GradleException` if `android/keystore.properties` is missing. `build.gradle.kts:137-147` sets `unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues = true` and forces `LANG=C.UTF-8` for all `Test` tasks (JVM `sun.jnu.encoding` is ASCII on a C-locale runner, and boot.js tests write Cyrillic filenames).

### 6.2 Test inventory (24 files, JVM unit tests)

| Path | Tests |
|---|---|
| `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/LlmClientTest.kt` (271) + `FakeHttpServer.kt` (111) | streaming/tool-call parsing |
| `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/AgentSettingsTest.kt` (85) | config |
| `agent/opencode/OpenCodeAgentTest.kt` (228), `OpenCodeToolsGateTest.kt` (151), `MiniShellTest.kt` (197), `ApplyPatchTest.kt` (154), `SessionsTest.kt` (140), `SkillsTest.kt` (108), `InstructionsTest.kt` (96), `HistoryTrimmerTest.kt` (121) | agent + tools + shell |
| `runtime/js/JsRuntimeTest.kt` (353) | real boot.js integration; reads `src/main/assets/node/boot.js` or `app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js` relative to the module dir (`:26-31`) |
| `runtime/npm/NpxRuntimeTest.kt` (151), `SemverTest.kt` (99), `TarReaderTest.kt` (139) | npm client |
| `core/FileOpsTest.kt` (204), `FileTreeTest.kt` (104), `WorkspaceTest.kt` (134) | file layer |
| `license/LicenseFormatTest.kt` (143), `MonotonicClockTest.kt` (99), `SharedLicenseTest.kt` (43) | license (golden vectors shared with `tools/keygen`) |
| `update/AppUpdateTest.kt` (80) | release parsing / version compare |
| `android/app/src/test/python/test_pocketrun.py` | the audit-hook jail |
| `tools/keygen/src/test/kotlin/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt` (141) | keygen |

**There is no `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/` directory** — `AppViewModel` (1602 lines, the file-manager state machine) and every Compose screen have **zero** unit tests, no Robolectric, no Compose UI tests, no instrumentation tests, no `androidTest` source set. The fingerprint-guard defect in §1.3 is exactly what that gap hides.

### 6.3 CI — `.github/workflows/`

**`android.yml`** — `Android`, triggers: push to any branch except `v*` tags, all PRs, `workflow_dispatch`. `ubuntu-24.04`, 60 min timeout, `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress`.
- checkout (`fetch-depth: 0`, `fetch-tags: true` — versionCode derives from the nearest tag)
- Temurin JDK 17; `setup-python` 3.13
- `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4`; Chaquopy cache (`~/.chaquopy`, `~/.gradle/caches/modules-2`)
- **`:app:testDebugUnitTest`** (`working-directory: android`)
- **`python3 -m unittest discover -s android/app/src/test/python -v`**
- `:app:assembleDebug`
- `:app:assembleRelease` only if secrets `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64/_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` exist (writes `android/keystore.jks` + `android/keystore.properties` from the repo root on purpose, then `cd android && ./gradlew`)
- uploads `pocketrun-apk` artifact

Second job `keygen`: Temurin 17 + `./gradlew --no-daemon test` in `tools/keygen`.

**`release.yml`** — `Release`, triggers on `v*` tags and `workflow_dispatch` (input `tag`). `permissions: contents: write`. Same tests, then **hard-fails** without the keystore secret. Names assets `PocketRun-<tag>-release.apk` / `-debug.apk` (this is what `AppUpdate.APK_SUFFIX = "-release.apk"` looks for) and publishes via `gh release create/upload --clobber`. Release notes explain the shared-key situation and the daily in-app update check.

**`build-hub-snapshot.yml`** — manual only. `curl`s the NPM-Hub work-backup snapshot from `raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/zen-panel@work-backup` (`repo.bundle` + `wip.patch` + `untracked.tar.gz` + `worktree.tar.gz`, with chunked large-blob reassembly and sha256 verification), pulls the signing keypair from the default branch by raw URL (`:115-127`), then `:app:assembleDebug` in `src/android`. Output artifact `pocketrun-snapshot-apk-<stamp>`.

### 6.4 Versioning

`versionCode = gitVersionCode()` — `major*1e6 + minor*1e3 + patch` from `git describe --tags --abbrev=0`, plus the commit count since that tag (`build.gradle.kts:21-45`); `versionName` from the tag with the `v` stripped (`:69`). `applicationIdSuffix = ".debug"` for debug builds (`:101`), so the debug APK is a genuinely different app id — which is why `AppUpdate` rejects debug-named assets.

### 6.5 `docs/PLAN.md` is stale

`docs/PLAN.md` still lists Node and npx as *"не начато"* (lines 17-18) although both are shipped and tested, and `MainActivity` as *"заглушка"* (line 137) although it is 15 lines of working code. 126:      * matches it or anything inside it - that is what makes a search reveal a

129:     fun build(root: File, expanded: Set<String>, filter: TreeFilter): List<FileNode> {
130:         if (!root.isDirectory) return emptyList()
131:         if (!filter.isFiltering) return walk(root, 0, expanded, filter.showHidden)
132:         val all = walk(root, 0, everythingExpanded = true, showHidden = filter.showHidden)

137:     private fun walk(
138:         dir: File,
139:         depth: Int,
140:         expanded: Set<String> = emptySet(),
141:         showHidden: Boolean = false,
142:         everythingExpanded: Boolean = false,
143:     ): List<FileNode> {
144:         if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return emptyList()
145:         val out = ArrayList<FileNode>()
146:         for (child in children(dir, showHidden)) {
147:             if (out.size >= MAX_NODES) break
148:             val kind = kindOf(child)
149:             out += node(child, depth, kind)
150:             if (kind != FileKind.FOLDER) continue
151:             val open = everythingExpanded || child.absolutePath in expanded
152:             if (open) out += walk(child, depth + 1, expanded, showHidden, everythingExpanded)

155:     }

169:             files = entries?.count { !it.isDirectory } ?: 0,

187:             val byKind = filter.kind == null || node.kind == filter.kind
188:             if (!byName || !byKind) continue

190:             var current = node.file.parentFile
191:             while (current != null && current.absolutePath.length >= root.absolutePath.length) {
192:                 keep += current.absolutePath
193:                 if (current.absolutePath == root.absolutePath) break
194:                 current = current.parentFile
195:             }
196:         }
197:         return keep

203:      * looking at it. Names, sizes and mtimes only - no nodes are built, so it is
204:      * safe to run every couple of seconds.
205:      */
206:     fun fingerprint(root: File): String {
207:         if (!root.isDirectory) return "-"
208:         var hash = 1125899906842597L
209:         var count = 0
210:         val stack = ArrayDeque<File>()
211:         stack.addLast(root)
212:         while (stack.isNotEmpty() && count < MAX_NODES) {
213:             val dir = stack.removeLast()
214:             for (child in dir.listFiles().orEmpty()) {
215:                 count++
216:                 if (child.isDirectory && child.name !in SKIP_DIRS) stack.addLast(child)
217:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.name.hashCode()
218:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.length()
219:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.lastModified()
220:             }
221:         }
222:         return "$count:${java.lang.Long.toHexString(hash)}"

Now I understand the folder-open bug completely. The fix is straightforward: the fingerprint guard doesn't account for `expandedDirs` or `treeFilter`. 

Two options:
- A: Pass `force = true` from toggleFolder/setTreeQuery/etc.
- B: Include expanded+filter state in the guard key.

Option B is better: it keeps the cheap-guard benefit for the watcher (which calls `rebuildTree()` with no force) while making explicit state changes always rebuild. Actually simpler: track a `treeKey` = fingerprint + hash of expanded set + filter. Let me do B — it's cleaner and fixes all 5 call sites at once.

Actually, the simplest correct approach that preserves intent: make the guard key incorporate the view state.

```kotlin
private fun viewStamp(dir: File): String =
    FileTree.fingerprint(dir) + "|" + _expandedDirs.value.hashCode() + "|" + _treeFilter.value
```

Then `rebuildTree()` compares `stamp` to `treePrint`. If expanded set or filter changed, stamp changes → rebuild. And the watcher calls rebuildTree() every 2s — if nothing changed, stamp same → skip. 

But there's a subtlety: the watcher runs on watchExecutor while toggleFolder runs on ioExecutor — both call rebuildTree. Race on `treePrint` and `_tree.value`. Pre-existing. Let me not worry too much but the stamp approach is actually more robust.

Hmm, but also: is a tree-only expand enough for "открытие папок"? The user says "кнопка открыть не работает" — the Open button. With the fix, tapping "Открыть папку" expands the folder and shows children inline. That's probably what they want — a file manager tree. But they might also want real navigation (enter folder, breadcrumb, go up). Let me consider: the report says there's no navigation at all. The user said "добавляй открытие папок а то кнопка открыть не работает" — "add folder opening, because the open button doesn't work". 

The minimal correct interpretation: make the folder open work. Expanding inline in the tree IS opening. I'll do that (fix the guard), plus wire the dead `onLongPress` since without it there's no way to inspect a file without opening it (which makes the action bar's other buttons — rename/delete/history — unreachable for files). Actually wait: `openFile` sets `_inspected.value = file`, so tapping a row does set inspected. So the action bar appears. OK so long-press is a nice-to-have but not blocking.

Actually, let me reconsider — the long press IS important for folders. Because: tap row → openFile → toggleFolder → expands. Then the row shows FolderOpen. Then to inspect a folder you tap again → collapses. So you can never have a folder both open AND inspected without it being collapsed. With the guard bug, tapping "Открыть папку" appeared to work (icon changed) — that's the misleading UI the report describes. Once I fix the guard, tapping "Открыть папку" would collapse the already-expanded folder. So I need to fix this properly:

- `openFile` on a folder: ensure it's expanded (idempotent "open"), and scroll/inspect it. Not a toggle.
- Row tap on a folder: toggle (that's the natural chevron behavior).
- Action bar "Открыть папку" for a folder: expand + it's meaningful. And add a "Свернуть"/collapse? 

Better design: separate the two intents.
- Row click → `toggleFolder` (chevron-like expand/collapse)
- Action bar "Открыть папку" → `openFolder` = expand without collapsing + inspect.

And add long-press via `combinedClickable` so users can inspect without toggling.

Also, should I add real navigation into a subfolder (like a directory browser with breadcrumb + "вверх")? That would be a bigger UI change and would conflict with the existing tree+expand model. The tree model already IS the navigation. I think making the tree work correctly + fixing the toggle/inspect conflict is the right scope. But let me ask the user, since "открытие папок" is ambiguous and I want to also confirm the "libraries" part.

Now, part 2: "добавь реальные встроенные node js и другие библиотеки которые агент сам скачает при необходимости если мне памяти достаточно а то у него уж много bash но пустышек"

So the user wants:
1. Real Node.js (not Rhino-pretending-to-be-node) — the fundamental issue is Rhino 1.8.1 can't parse modern JS (class/async/import), so npm packages mostly fail.
2. Other libraries.
3. Agent self-downloads on demand (this already exists for npm, but is broken by the parser limitation).
4. Fill in the bash stubs.

Options for real Node on Android:
- **QuickJS (quickjs-android / quickjs-ng AAR)** — real ES2023 engine, tiny (~2MB), fast, runs modern JS. Available as a prebuilt AAR from jitpack: `com.whl.quickjs:quickjs-android`. But needs network at build time to resolve, and adds JNI.
- **GraalJS** — heavy (~30MB+), Truffle, very large.
- **Hermes** — React Native's engine, exposed via `hermes-android` AAR; lacks the host object API surface but can be used with JSI... complex.

- **duktape** — old ES5/ES2015 partial.

Best fit: **QuickJS via a prebuilt AAR** — that's what actually delivers "real node js with modern npm packages".

That means expanding/collapsing a folder... wait, `_expandedDirs.value` change doesn't alter the fingerprint (fingerprint only lists names/sizes/mtimes). Hmm! So the first toggle: fingerprint is unchanged since last rebuild → rebuildTree returns early → the tree is never rebuilt → **the folder does not expand**. That's a real bug!

Wait, careful. Let's trace: the watch loop calls `rebuildTree()` every WATCH_INTERVAL_MS (no force), which updates `treePrint` and builds the tree with the current `_expandedDirs`. Hmm, so on the next watch tick, the tree WILL be rebuilt with the new expanded set, because `treePrint` will still equal the current fingerprint but the rebuild is skipped... no wait, the watch loop also calls `rebuildTree()` with force=false, which would also return early since print == treePrint.

Hmm, so: the initial `select()` calls `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)` → treePrint = P, tree built. Then user toggles folder F → `_expandedDirs += F`, `rebuildTreeAsync()` → force=false, print == treePrint == P → return early. Tree NOT rebuilt. Then the watch loop: `rebuildTree()` → print == treePrint → early return. So the tree stays stale forever until the fingerprint changes on disk (a file is written/modified).

So **the only thing that makes the folder actually expand is an unrelated disk change in the project folder**. That's a genuine "Open folder does nothing" bug. That's a very significant finding. Let me double check WATCH_INTERVAL_MS and confirm there's no other trigger.

Let me check the rest of AppViewModel for constants and `init`.

Also `_tree.value` is only assigned in rebuildTree. Let's grep for `_tree.value =`.

Also, importantly: `expanded` from `viewModel.expandedDirs` is read in ProjectsScreen but only used for the icon. So even the icon wouldn't update until the tree is rebuilt.

Confirmed: `rebuildTree(force = false)` has the fingerprint guard, and `toggleFolder` calls `rebuildTreeAsync()` with `force = false`. Since the fingerprint does not depend on the expanded set, the tree rebuild is skipped → the folder does not expand.

Let me double-check the flow once more:
- After `select(project)` → `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)` → treePrint = P1, _tree built.
- Watch loop ticks every 2s: `rebuildTree()` → fingerprint P1 == treePrint → return early. So the watch loop itself never rebuilds once the fingerprint is stable. That's the intent (cheap).
- User taps folder row → `openFile` → `_inspected` set, `toggleFolder` → `_expandedDirs += path`, `rebuildTreeAsync()` → `rebuildTree(force=false)` → fingerprint P1 == treePrint P1 → **return early**. Tree unchanged. FOLDER DOES NOT OPEN.

So the bug is: the fingerprint-based rebuild guard makes the expand/collapse a no-op until some file in the project changes on disk. And even then, the watch loop's `rebuildTree()` would pick up the new expanded set at the tick after the change. So the folder would suddenly open by itself later, e.g. when the agent writes a file.

Note also that `expandedDirs` StateFlow IS updated, so the `TreeRow` icon would switch to FolderOpen... but `expanded` is only recomputed for rows that exist in `tree`; the row still exists (the folder node is in the tree), so the icon WOULD flip to the open-folder icon while the children do NOT appear. So the visual feedback is actively misleading: icon shows "open" but the contents are not listed.

That's a very strong finding. Also, the second click collapses it (toggling the set back), so the icon flips back. The user sees a folder icon toggling with no content ever appearing → "opening a folder does nothing".

Second issue: even if it worked, the semantics are "toggle expand", not "navigate into folder" — there's no navigation/current-dir state, no breadcrumb, no "up" button. The `FileActionBar` "Открыть папку" is bound to the same toggle, and since long-press already sets `inspected` without expanding, tapping "Открыть папку" expands... but the row tap already expanded → so the button collapses it. Let me note both.

Third: the FileTreeTest at line 69 mentions "src/ was never expanded". Let me read FileTreeTest to see what's covered — tests call `FileTree.build` directly, so they wouldn't catch the ViewModel guard bug (no test for AppViewModel).

15:  * tarball downloads. Works against registry.npmjs.org; the same endpoints are
16:  * served by any npm mirror (GPR, Verdaccio, …) by changing [baseUrl].
17:  *
18:  * A registry is a code source: whoever answers it chooses the JavaScript the
19:  * app evaluates. Two things are therefore checked on every tarball — the digest
20:  * the metadata promised, and that the download really comes from the registry
21:  * the metadata came from. Metadata without a digest is refused, exactly like
22:  * npm does.
23:  */
24: class NpmRegistry(private val baseUrl: String = "https://registry.npmjs.org/") {
25: 
26:     class RegistryException(message: String) : Exception(message)
27: 
28:     /** Full metadata document for [name]; scoped names are URL-encoded. */
29:     fun metadata(name: String): JSONObject {
30:         val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(name, "UTF-8")
31:         val text = http(baseUrl + encoded) { conn ->
32:             conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
33:         }
34:         return try {
35:             JSONObject(text)
36:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
37:             throw RegistryException("registry вернул не-JSON ответ для $name")
38:         }
39:     }
40: 
41:     /**
42:      * Downloads the tarball at [url] into [dest] and proves it is the one the
43:      * metadata described.
44:      *
45:      * @param integrity the `dist.integrity` value (`sha512-<base64>`, possibly
46:      *   several space-separated digests). Required: a packument without it
47:      *   cannot be trusted to be the real package.
48:      */
49:     fun downloadTarball(url: String, dest: File, integrity: String?) {
50:         requireTrusted(url)
51:         val expected = requireIntegrity(integrity, url)
52:         http(url, dest)
53:         val actual = digestOf(dest, expected.algorithm)
54:         if (actual != expected.b64) {
55:             // Never leave a tarball that failed its check on disk: the caller
56:             // would happily extract it.
57:             dest.delete()
58:             val detail = expected.algorithms.joinToString(", ")
59:             throw RegistryException(
60:                 "несовпадение контрольной суммы tarball (ожидалась $detail, получено " +
61:                     "${actual.take(12)}…) — пакет отклонён",
62:             )
63:         }
64:     }
65: 
66:     // ------------------------------------------------------------- digests
67: 
68:     /** One expected digest: the algorithm and the base64 it must equal. */
69:     private data class Expected(val algorithm: String, val b64: String, val algorithms: List<String>)
70: 
71:     private fun requireIntegrity(integrity: String?, url: String): Expected {
72:         val digests = integrity?.split(' ', '\t')?.map { it.trim() }?.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.orEmpty()
73:         val parsed = digests.mapNotNull { parseDigest(it) }
74:         if (parsed.isEmpty()) {
75:             throw RegistryException(
76:                 "в метаданных нет integrity для ${url.take(120)} — пакет без контрольной суммы не ставится",
77:             )
78:         }
79:         // The strongest digest is the one that is checked; npm does the same.
80:         val strongest = parsed.maxBy { it.first.length }
81:         return Expected(strongest.first, strongest.second, parsed.map { it.first }.distinct())
82:     }
83: 
84:     private fun parseDigest(value: String): Pair<String, String>? {
85:         val dash = value.indexOf('-')
86:         if (dash <= 0) return null
87:         val algorithm = value.substring(0, dash).lowercase()
88:         if (algorithm !in SUPPORTED) return null
89:         val b64 = value.substring(dash + 1)
90:         return runCatching { Base64.getDecoder().decode(b64) }.map { algorithm to b64 }.getOrNull()
91:     }
92: 
93:     private fun digestOf(file: File, algorithm: String): String {
94:         val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance(algorithm)
95:         file.inputStream().use { input ->
96:             val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
97:             while (true) {
98:                 val n = input.read(buf)
99:                 if (n < 0) break
100:                 digest.update(buf, 0, n)
101:             }
102:         }
103:         return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(digest.digest())
104:     }
105: 
106:     /**
107:      * A tarball must be https and must live on the registry the metadata came
108:      * from — otherwise a compromised packument can point the app at an
109:      * arbitrary host and the integrity check would only prove that *that* host
110:      * serves what it said.
111:      */
112:     private fun requireTrusted(url: String) {
113:         val parsed = runCatching { URL(url) }.getOrElse {
114:             throw RegistryException("некорректный tarball URL: ${url.take(120)}")
115:         }
116:         if (parsed.protocol != "https") {
117:             throw RegistryException("tarball должен скачиваться по https, а не ${parsed.protocol}")
118:         }
119:         val registry = runCatching { URL(baseUrl).host }.getOrElse { "" }
120:         val host = parsed.host.lowercase()
121:         val allowed = registry.lowercase()
122:         if (allowed.isNotEmpty() && host != allowed && !host.endsWith(".$allowed")) {
123:             throw RegistryException(
124:                 "tarball лежит на $host, а метаданные пришли с $allowed — пакет отклонён",
125:             )
126:         }
127:     }
128: 
129:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- http
130: 
131:     private inline fun http(url: String, prepare: (HttpURLConnection) -> Unit = {}): String {
132:         val conn = open(url)
133:         prepare(conn)
134:         val status = conn.responseCode
135:         val text = streamText(conn, status)
136:         if (status !in 200..299) {
137:             throw RegistryException("HTTP $status для ${url.take(120)}: ${text.take(200)}")
138:         }
139:         return text
140:     }
141: 
142:     private fun http(url: String, dest: File) {
143:         val conn = open(url)
144:         val status = conn.responseCode
145:         if (status !in 200..299) {
146:             val text = streamText(conn, status)
147:             throw RegistryException("HTTP $status для ${url.take(120)}: ${text.take(200)}")
148:         }
149:         copy(conn.inputStream, dest)
150:     }
151: 
152:     private fun copy(input: InputStream, dest: File) {
153:         FileOutputStream(dest).use { out ->
154:             val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
155:             while (true) {
156:                 val n = input.read(buf)
157:                 if (n < 0) break
158:                 out.write(buf, 0, n)
159:             }
160:         }
161:     }
162: 
163:     private fun open(url: String): HttpURLConnection {
164:         if (!url.startsWith("https://") && !url.startsWith("http://")) {
165:             throw RegistryException("поддерживаются только http(s) URL")
166:         }
167:         val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
168:         conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
169:         conn.readTimeout = 120_000
170:         conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
171:         // npmjs.org rejects requests without a user agent.
172:         conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "pocketrun-npm/1.2 (Rhino)")
173:         return conn
174:     }
175: 
176:     private fun streamText(conn: HttpURLConnection, status: Int): String {
177:         val stream = if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream
178:         if (stream == null) return ""
179:         // Success bodies (package metadata) can be megabytes; only error text is capped.
180:         return if (status in 200..299) {
181:             stream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
182:         } else {
183:             stream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText().take(8_192) }
184:         }
185:     }
186: 
187:     companion object {
188:         private val SUPPORTED = setOf("sha512", "sha384", "sha256", "sha1")
189:     }
190: }

289:         "read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch", "skill", "question", "todowrite" -> true
290:         "github" -> args.optString("op") in GitHubClient.READ_OPS
291:         else -> false
292:     }
293: 
294:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools
295: 
296:     private fun base(): File = projectDir ?: workspace.root
297: 
298:     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
299:         val command = args.getString("command")
300:         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
301:         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
302:         val out = buildString {
303:             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
304:             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
305:         }
306:         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
307:     }
308: 
309:     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
310:         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
311:         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
312:         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
313:         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
314:         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
315:         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
316:         val lines = text.lines()
317:         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
318:         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
319:         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
320:         val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
321:         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
322:             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
323:     }
324: 
325:     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
326:         val path = args.getString("filePath")
327:         if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
328:         val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
329:         f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
330:         f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
331:         return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
332:     }
333: 
334:     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
335:         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
336:         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
337:         val old = args.getString("oldString")
338:         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
339:         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
340:         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
341:         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
342:         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
343:         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
344:             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
345:         }
346:         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
347:         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
348:         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
349:     }
350: 
351:     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
352:         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
353:         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
354:         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
355:         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
356:         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
357:         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
358:         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
359:     }
360: 
361:     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
362:         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
363:         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
364:         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
365:         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
366:         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
367:             if (f.isFile) {
368:                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
369:                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
370:             }
371:         }
372:         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
373:         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
374:             .take(200)
375:             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
376:     }
377: 
378:     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
379:         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
380:         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
381:         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
382:         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
383:         val out = StringBuilder()
384:         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
385:             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
386:             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
387:             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
388:             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
389:             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
390:             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
391:                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
392:             }
393:         }
394:         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
395:     }
396: 
397:     private fun doApplyPatch(args: JSONObject): String {
398:         return try {
399:             val result = ApplyPatch.apply(args.getString("patchText")) { path -> resolve(path) }
400:             buildString {
401:                 if (result.applied.isNotEmpty()) appendLine(result.applied.joinToString("\n"))
402:                 if (result.skipped.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("skipped: " + result.skipped.joinToString("; "))
403:             }.trim().ifEmpty { "патч не содержал операций" }
404:         } catch (e: ApplyPatch.PatchException) {
405:             "error: ${e.message}"
406:         }
407:     }
408: 
409:     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
410:         val arr = args.optJSONArray("todos") ?: return "error: нужен массив todos"
411:         val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
412:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
413:             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
414:             val content = o.optString("content")
415:             if (content.isEmpty()) continue
416:             val status = o.optString("status", "pending")
417:             list += Sessions.Todo(
418:                 id = o.optString("id").ifEmpty { "t$i" },
419:                 content = content,
420:                 status = if (status in listOf("pending", "in_progress", "completed")) status else "pending",
421:             )
422:         }
423:         todos = list
424:         onTodos?.invoke(list)
425:         return "todos updated: ${list.size}"
426:     }
427: 
428:     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
429:         val url = args.getString("url")
430:         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
431:         return try {
432:             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
433:             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
434:             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
435:             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
436:             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
437:             val status = conn.responseCode
438:             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
439:                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
440:             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
441:             val text = stripHtml(body)
442:             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
443:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
444:             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
445:         }
446:     }
447: 
448:     private fun doSkill(args: JSONObject): String {
449:         val name = args.getString("name")
450:         val skill = skills.load(name, projectDir)
451:             ?: return "error: навык '$name' не найден. Доступны: ${skills.discover(projectDir).joinToString(", ") { it.name }.ifEmpty { "(нет)" }}"
452:         return skill.content.take(32 * 1024)
453:     }
454: 
455:     private fun doQuestion(args: JSONObject): String {
456:         val arr = args.optJSONArray("questions") ?: return "error: нужен массив questions"
457:         val questions = mutableListOf<Question>()
458:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
459:             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
460:             val opts = o.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
461:             questions += Question(
462:                 header = o.optString("header").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
463:                 question = o.optString("question").ifEmpty { "Вопрос" },
464:                 options = (0 until opts.length()).map { opts.optString(it) },
465:             )
466:         }
467:         if (questions.isEmpty()) return "error: нет вопросов"
468:         val asker = questionAsker ?: return "(вопросы недоступны в этом режиме)"
469:         return asker(questions)
470:     }
471: 
472:     private fun doGitHub(args: JSONObject): String {
473:         if (githubToken.isBlank()) {
474:             return "error: GitHub-токен не задан — откройте ⚙ → GitHub и вставьте PAT (scopes repo, workflow)"
475:         }
476:         val gh = GitHubClient(githubToken)
477:         val op = args.optString("op")
478:         return try {
479:             when (op) {
480:                 "me" -> gh.me()
481:                 "repo_list" -> gh.repoList()
482:                 "repo_create" -> gh.repoCreate(
483:                     name = args.getString("name"),
484:                     private = args.optBoolean("private", true),
485:                     description = args.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
486:                 )
487:                 "push" -> {
488:                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("files") ?: return "error: нужен массив files[{path,content}]"
489:                     val files = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
490:                     for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
491:                         val f = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
492:                         val p = f.optString("path")
493:                         if (p.isNotEmpty()) files += p to f.optString("content")
494:                     }
495:                     if (files.isEmpty()) return "error: files пуст"
496:                     gh.pushFiles(args.getString("repo"), files, args.optString("message", "update"), args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
497:                 }
498:                 "file_get" -> gh.fileGet(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("path"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
499:                 "file_delete" -> {
500:                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("paths")
501:                         ?: return "error: нужен массив paths[]"
502:                     val paths = (0 until arr.length()).mapNotNull { arr.optString(it).takeIf { p -> p.isNotEmpty() } }
503:                     if (paths.isEmpty()) return "error: paths пуст"
504:                     gh.deleteFiles(
505:                         args.getString("repo"), paths,
506:                         args.optString("message", "remove files"),
507:                         args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
508:                     )
509:                 }
510:                 "workflow_create" -> gh.workflowCreate(args.getString("repo"), args.optString("filename", "run.yml"), args.getString("yaml"))
511:                 "dispatch" -> gh.dispatch(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("workflow"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
512:                 "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
513:                 "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
514:                     repo = args.getString("repo"),
515:                     runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
516:                     timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),
517:                     isCancelled = { cancelCheck?.invoke() == true },
518:                 )
519:                 "run_cancel" -> gh.runCancel(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
520:                 "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
521:                 "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })
522:                 "artifact_download" -> gh.artifactDownload(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("artifact_id"))
523:                 "api" -> gh.api(args.optString("method", "GET"), args.getString("api_path"), args.optString("body").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
524:                 else -> "error: неизвестная операция '$op' (me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api)"
525:             }
526:         } catch (e: GitHubClient.GitHubException) {
527:             "error: ${e.message}"
528:         }
529:     }

533:     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
534: 
535:     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
536:         var count = 0
537:         var idx = 0
538:         while (true) {
539:             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
540:             if (idx < 0) return count
541:             count++
542:             idx += needle.length
543:         }
544:     }

546:     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
547:         val regex = buildString {
548:             append('^')
549:             var i = 0
550:             while (i < pattern.length) {
551:                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
552:                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
553:                     '?' -> append('.')
554:                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
555:                 }
556:                 i++
557:             }
558:             append('$')
559:         }
560:         return Regex(regex)
561:     }

package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.js.JsRuntime
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.npm.NpxRuntime
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * The opencode tool set, with opencode's names and semantics: bash, edit,
 * write, read, list, glob, grep, apply_patch, todowrite, webfetch, skill and
 * question. Everything runs inside the workspace sandbox; the `question`
 * tool surfaces an interactive prompt in the chat UI.
 */
class OpenCodeTools(
    private val workspace: Workspace,
    jsRuntime: JsRuntime,
    npxRuntime: NpxRuntime,
    private val projectDir: File?,
    private val githubToken: String = "",
) {

    companion object {
        private const val MAX_READ = 32 * 1024
        private const val MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT = 16 * 1024
        private const val MAX_WEB = 24 * 1024

        /** A single bash command may run this long — npm installs and builds need it. */
        const val BASH_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000L
    }

    private val shell = MiniShell(workspace, jsRuntime, npxRuntime)
    private val skills = Skills(workspace)

    /** Answers pending questions; set by the agent runner. */
    @Volatile
    var questionAsker: ((List<Question>) -> String)? = null

    /**
     * Manual confirmation gate: return false to refuse the tool call. Only
     * invoked for mutating tools (writes, edits, bash, github mutations);
     * reads always run. Set by the runner when the mode is "manual".
     */
    @Volatile
    var toolApprover: ((name: String, argsJson: String) -> Boolean)? = null

    /**
     * Polled by long-waiting tools (github run_wait) so that ⏹ actually stops
     * a turn that is only waiting for a CI run.
     */
    @Volatile
    var cancelCheck: (() -> Boolean)? = null

    /** Todo updates flow to the session and UI through this hook. */
    @Volatile
    var onTodos: ((List<Sessions.Todo>) -> Unit)? = null

    /** The current todo list; seeded from the session before each turn. */
    var todos: List<Sessions.Todo> = emptyList()

    data class Question(val header: String?, val question: String, val options: List<String>)

    fun definitions(): JSONArray = JSONArray().apply {
        fun tool(name: String, description: String, properties: JSONObject, required: List<String>) {
            put(
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("type", "function")
                    put(
                        "function",
                        JSONObject().apply {
                            put("name", name)
                            put("description", description)
                            put(
                                "parameters",
                                JSONObject().apply {
                                    put("type", "object")
                                    put("properties", properties)
                                    put("required", JSONArray(required))
                                },
                            )
                        },
                    )
                },
            )
        }

        fun str(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "string").put("description", desc)
        fun int(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "integer").put("description", desc)
        fun bool(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "boolean").put("description", desc)
        fun arr(name: String, desc: String, itemSchema: JSONObject = str("item", "")) =
            JSONObject().put("type", "array").put("items", itemSchema).put("description", desc)

        tool(
            "bash",
            "Execute a shell command in the sandboxed project directory. Available commands: ${MiniShell.COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")}. " +
                "python runs CPython 3.13 (stdlib only), node runs the Node-compatible layer, npx installs/runs pure-JS npm packages. " +
                "Supports quoting, && , | and > >> redirection. No git, no package managers other than npx.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("command", str("command", "the shell command to run"))
                .put("timeout", int("timeout", "optional timeout in milliseconds (max ${BASH_TIMEOUT_MS})")),
            listOf("command"),
        )
        tool(
            "read",
            "Read a text file (max ${MAX_READ} chars). Supports optional offset (1-based line) and limit.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("offset", int("offset", "1-based line number to start from"))
                .put("limit", int("limit", "number of lines to read")),
            listOf("filePath"),
        )
        tool(
            "write",
            "Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Parent directories are created automatically.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("content", str("content", "full file content")),
            listOf("filePath", "content"),
        )
        tool(
            "edit",
            "Edit an existing file by replacing an exact string. oldString must be unique in the file unless replaceAll is true.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("oldString", str("oldString", "the exact text to replace"))
                .put("newString", str("newString", "the replacement text"))
                .put("replaceAll", bool("replaceAll", "replace every occurrence")),
            listOf("filePath", "oldString", "newString"),
        )
        tool(
            "list",
            "List a directory of the project.",
            JSONObject().put("path", str("path", "directory path, '.' is the project root")),
            listOf("path"),
        )
        tool(
            "glob",
            "Find files by glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py', 'src/**/*.js'), sorted by modification time.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("pattern", str("pattern", "glob pattern"))
                .put("path", str("path", "directory to search in, defaults to the project root")),
            listOf("pattern"),
        )
        tool(
            "grep",
            "Search file contents with a regular expression; returns 'path:line: text' matches.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("pattern", str("pattern", "regular expression"))
                .put("path", str("path", "directory to search in, defaults to the project root"))
                .put("include", str("include", "glob filter for file names, e.g. '*.py'")),
            listOf("pattern"),
        )
        tool(
            "apply_patch",
            "Apply a patch in the *** Begin Patch format with *** Add File / *** Update File (+- lines) / *** Move to / *** Delete File sections.",
            JSONObject().put("patchText", str("patchText", "the full patch text")),
            listOf("patchText"),
        )
        tool(
            "todowrite",
            "Create or update the session todo list. Replaces the whole list; statuses: pending, in_progress, completed.",
            JSONObject().put(
                "todos",
                arr(
                    "todos",
                    "the full todo list",
                    JSONObject().put("type", "object")
                        .put(
                            "properties",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("id", str("id", "stable id"))
                                .put("content", str("content", "task text"))
                                .put("status", str("status", "pending | in_progress | completed")),
                        )
                        .put("required", JSONArray(listOf("content", "status"))),
                ),
            ),
            listOf("todos"),
        )
        tool(
            "webfetch",
            "Fetch an http(s) URL and return the page as plain text (HTML stripped), max ${MAX_WEB} chars.",
            JSONObject().put("url", str("url", "the URL to fetch")),
            listOf("url"),
        )
        tool(
            "skill",
            "Load a skill (a SKILL.md file) and return its full content. ${"\n"}${skills.availableSkillsXml(projectDir)}",
            JSONObject().put("name", str("name", "skill name to load")),
            listOf("name"),
        )
        tool(
            "question",
            "Ask the user questions with optional choices; use this to clarify requirements or offer directions.",
            JSONObject().put(
                "questions",
                arr(
                    "questions",
                    "one or more questions",
                    JSONObject().put("type", "object")
                        .put(
                            "properties",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("header", str("header", "short header"))
                                .put("question", str("question", "the question text"))
                                .put("options", arr("options", "answer options", str("option", ""))),
                        )
                        .put("required", JSONArray(listOf("question"))),
                ),
            ),
            listOf("questions"),
        )
        tool(
            "github",
            "Work with GitHub through its REST API: repositories, files, and **GitHub Actions runners**. " +
                "Runners (runs-on: ubuntu-latest) are full Linux machines — there you can run npm packages, " +
                "opencode itself (npm i -g opencode-ai; opencode run \"…\"), compilers, tests — the heavy work " +
                "the mobile sandbox cannot do. Typical flow: repo_create → push (code + .github/workflows/run.yml " +
                "with `on: workflow_dispatch`, all files in ONE commit) → dispatch → run_wait (blocks until the run " +
                "finishes and returns conclusion, jobs and the log tail) → artifacts/artifact_download. " +
                "Never poll `runs` in a loop: run_wait does it in a single call. " +
